scope: Conditional complete B/P comparison at both additional registered starting phases; never select only a favorable phase
eligibility: Root confirms the lead gate passed and all four broader jobs were run and sealed; retain early-ended or regressed outcomes
shared_axes: One camera/world XY scale and common metric ranges across both starting phases and all four cases
ended_case_policy: Hold only the final actual saved pose with ENDED / NO LATER OBSERVATION, show exact observed coverage, and stop its trace
rendering_boundary: Reuse the frozen lead helper's static-display functions without rebinding its path globals; no controller, observer, forecast, collision solve or physics integration
inference_boundary: Neutral descriptive evidence; each starting phase is assessed separately by the registered scientific gates
